Security vulnerabilities must not be reported here. Follow the [security policy](../../docs/SECURITY.md).

Search existing issues and review the [support guide](../../docs/SUPPORT.md) before filing.

## Problem

What user problem or limitation should be addressed? Include the affected client or workflow.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the result you want, without prescribing unnecessary implementation details.

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds or other approaches have you tried?

## Additional context

Add concise examples or references that help define the request.
